about: Send push notifications from your own server, and prove they work on a real phone. One self-hosted, zero-dependency toolkit with two parts that start together and are already linked.

features.title: Beacon, your push server
features.body: Web Push for every PWA, FCM for Android, in-app banners and ntfy, Bark, Gotify and Apprise channels.

features.title: Targeting and scheduling
features.body: Segments, schedules, digests, multi-step escalation, templates and per-user preferences.

features.title: Tether, your device lab
features.body: Your Android phone in the browser: a live HD screen, recorded QA flows and notification checks.

features.title: Every phone at once
features.body: Run one recorded flow on every connected phone at the same time.

features.title: Performance budgets
features.body: Startup, jank, memory and CPU budgets, Perfetto traces and LeakCanary leak checks.

features.title: Agent skills included
features.body: Claude Code and Codex skills plus a CLI drive both parts.
